title: ColdStartPlan
description: Execution-neutral, content-free cold-start plan with only opaque identity, protocol, descriptor digest, candidate limit, and expiry.

candidate_limit.description: The GRANT, not the ask. Always <= the requested candidate_limit and <= the server's policy ceiling, which is lower than this wire bound (200 at time of writing). The wire bound stays 1000 so the ceiling can be retuned as policy without a contract change; clients MUST size against this returned value and never against their own request.
